variants.headline: Home world raises its demands
variants.body: The home world has raised what it demands of the colony. The gazette records the development as a matter deserving careful attention in the public interest.

variants.headline: A larger claim on the colony
variants.body: The demands placed on the colony by the home world have increased. The gazette records the development as a matter deserving careful attention in the public interest.

variants.headline: Distant authority asks for more
variants.body: The home world is demanding more from {colony}. The gazette records the development as a matter deserving careful attention in the public interest.
